purpose: Correct only the failed shared readout by separating normalized structural-geometry regression from place association, using the exact sealed 180-observation cache from V1 before any longer training.

sampling.rule: Consume the sealed V1 cache and manifest without selecting or regenerating rows: exactly 18 C01 c1_mixed observations and 10 physical nodes from each S01-S10 family.

raw_sources: sealed V1 structural-node targets and degrees
source.license_or_allowed_use: Project-generated research assets; upstream redistribution conditions remain unchanged.

teacher.source: Unchanged sealed 44-D construction-program structural descriptor, degree and same-node scoring identity from V1. Identity forms training pairs only and is forbidden from forward inputs.
teacher.valid_mask: All 180 cached observations were already validated to contain a causal five-frame observation and at least one incident primitive port.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph/planner execution. Place embedding only proposes candidates; the separately passed fixed 16 m graph-consistency mechanism remains mandatory for later merge validation.
teacher.student_inputs: Only the sealed endpoint geometry features and endpoint confidence produced from causal LiDAR by the frozen primitive backbone.

split.fit: The exact same 180 C01 observations are optimized and evaluated because this is a corrective memorization/readiness gate, not a generalization claim.
split.selection: C07 read count is exactly zero.
split.strict_test: C08-C10 and M-TARE read count is exactly zero.
split.historical_pollution_audit: V1 failure determines only the readout factorization. It does not change samples, labels, steps or gates; no C07/C08 result selects parameters.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.optimization: Exactly 500 full-batch dual-readout-only AdamW updates with a frozen cosine schedule from lr 0.002 to 0.00002 and weight decay 0; no backbone inference or update.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.loss: Geometry uses analytic per-dimension scales from descriptor semantics, never fitted statistics. Final total loss must improve at least 95% and raw geometry RMSE must be <=0.01.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.association: Independent normalized association embedding; on 1530 same-task candidate pairs the tie-safe nonempty operating point must achieve precision >=0.99 and recall >=0.95.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.system: All gradients finite, endpoint permutation invariance <=2e-6, final replay exact, sealed cache/manifest unchanged and zero C07-C10/graph/M-TARE.

estimated_cost.compute: No LiDAR/backbone forward; exactly 500 full-batch updates of one dual readout on 180 cached observations

failure_policy: Any failure stops this student interface before one-seed training. Do not increase steps, regenerate samples, inspect C07, lower gates or unfreeze the backbone.
retention: Keep the compact dual-readout checkpoint, metrics, diagnostic PNG/PDF/SVG, environment, logs, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal; retain the source V1 failure unchanged as an ablation.

approval.scope: One immutable corrective using the exact sealed 180-observation cache and exactly 500 dual-readout-only updates; zero C07-C10, graph or M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly authorized continuous optimal in-scope execution without routine approval prompts; V1 pre-registered readout-only fallback selected option A.
